patterns.what_worked: Restored 2.1.8 in exactly the 8 owned fields after a rogue read-only desk (the resumed perf-audit turn) wrote 2.2.0 at 14:11. The tree had also gained the fix desks' real work (main.lua +194/-44 and 8 other files), so the restore had to be surgical: I recorded the pre-restore main.lua sha256, edited only line 5, then proved with hash reconstruction (sed line 5 back to 2.2.0 reproduces the exact pre-restore hash) that no other byte changed. The 7 TOCs diff 1/1 each vs HEAD; only the 8 owned files have the 14:47:39 mtime, fix-desk files keep 14:22-14:38. toc_check stayed 1104/0.
patterns.what_was_hard: The dispatch's 'scoped diff = 8 files/8 pairs' criterion can no longer be read literally for main.lua: its diff legitimately carries the fix desks' hunks (+194/-44) now. Proved the version-line pairs separately (exactly 8 pairs) and proved non-interference with the hash reconstruction instead of a plain diffstat. Also the /tmp snapshot was cleaned mid-turn, so the stronger hash proof replaced it.
patterns.skill_gap: Still no durable pin guards version-field sync, and this incident is exactly the failure mode such a pin would catch (a rogue lane silently changed 8 live fields and only human/Lead review caught it). Filed as the follow-up; tests/ is outside this lane's write scope.
